description: Additional structural-error coverage for section loading: a differently malformed YAML document, a whitespace-only document that parses to empty (empty_config), a section name absent from a multi-section document, a section that declares only a 'dirs' list but neither 'templates' nor 'kubectl', an empty section name against a richer config, and the reserved shared section name when the shared block itself carries templates. Each prints a single 'error=<category>' line.

input.config:
common:
  k8s_namespace: ns
backend:
  templates:
    - template: backend.yaml.j2
database:
  templates:
    - template: db.yaml.j2

common:
  k8s_namespace: ns
only_dirs:
  dirs:
    - dst: /tmp/output/
  some_var: 42

common:
  k8s_namespace: ns
web:
  templates:
    - template: web.yaml.j2

common:
  k8s_namespace: ns
  templates:
    - template: shared.yaml.j2
